meta.title: Scenario: post-merger integration (Confluence Group)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (post-merger) with seed 20261107. 36 members of a company formed from two legacy organisations, recorded in the legacy_org attribute; every team mixes both. Within teams and across them, ties are stronger among people from the same legacy organisation. Northbank respondents rate generously and Southbank respondents harshly, by about one scale point. INT01, the integration lead, is sought for advice by most of the company and many depend on their output (the advice and workflow dependency layers are enabled). Four Technology members across the legacy line (TEC03, TEC05, TEC06, TEC08) find each other draining (energy) and report personal friction (the conflict layers are enabled). CUS12 joined last week: they know only their manager, and marked valence and energy “does not apply” for everyone else, as everyone else did for them. Four Southbank members (FIN04, TEC02, TEC08, CUS02) answered about half the survey.
